description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Offers" name="Offers" messageRef="Msg_Offers" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_OffersReceived"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderSingleShop" name="Order cheapest parts from one shop"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderMerge" name="Parts ordered"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstBatchArrives" name="First parts batch arrives">

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_FirstReceiptSplit" name="Split after first batch"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ReceiveRemainingBatches" name="Receive remaining parts batches"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RemainingBatches" name="Remaining batches received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildMerge" name="Build loop merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build" name="Build with parts in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildFinished" name="Building finished?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BelowFive" name="Has stock of a part dropped below 5?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BelowThree" name="Has stock of a part dropped below 3?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ZeroCheck" name="Has stock of a part dropped to zero?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder fastest parts"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Start_Query" sourceRef="StartEvent_ProjectNeedsParts" targetRef="SendTask_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Query_Offers" sourceRef="SendTask_QueryShops" targetRef="Event_OffersReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Offers_Collect" sourceRef="Event_OffersReceived" targetRef="UserTask_CollectOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Collect_List" sourceRef="UserTask_CollectOffers" targetRef="Task_CreatePartsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_List_Split" sourceRef="Task_CreatePartsList" targetRef="Gateway_SingleShopEnough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Single_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SingleShopEnough" targetRef="SendTask_OrderSingleShop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Single_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SingleShopEnough" targetRef="SendTask_OrderSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_OrderSingle_Merge" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderSingleShop" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_OrderSeveral_Merge" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_OrderMerge_Batch" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderMerge" targetRef="Event_FirstBatchArrives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Batch_Split" sourceRef="Event_FirstBatchArrives" targetRef="Gateway_FirstReceiptSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Split_ReceiveFirst" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstReceiptSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Split_ReceiveRemaining" sourceRef="Gateway_FirstReceiptSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRemainingBatches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ReceiveRemaining_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRemainingBatches" targetRef="EndEvent_RemainingBatches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_ReceiveFirst_Start" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Start_BuildMerge" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_BuildMerge_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildMerge" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Build_Finished" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="Gateway_BuildFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Finished_End" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildFinished" targetRef="EndEvent_Built"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_NotFinished_Below5" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildFinished" targetRef="Gateway_BelowFive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Below5_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Below5_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowFive" targetRef="Gateway_BelowThree"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Below3_No" name="No (below 5 but not below 3)" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="SendTask_ReorderCheapest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Below3_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BelowThree" targetRef="Gateway_ZeroCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Zero_No" name="No (below 3 but not zero)" sourceRef="Gateway_ZeroCheck" targetRef="SendTask_ReorderFastest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Zero_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ZeroCheck" targetRef="Task_WriteComplaintMail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Cheapest_Merge" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Fastest_Merge" sourceRef="SendTask_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Mail_Merge" sourceRef="Task_WriteComplaintMail" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
